description: Launch the 'Redraw the given image' activity in GCompris (found in the Discovery/Art category, icon shows a grid/easel). The goal is to copy the colored grid pattern shown on the left side to the blank grid on the right side. Click the cells on the right grid to cycle through colors until they match the reference pattern. Complete Level 1. Once finished (when the success animation appears or the grids match completely), take a screenshot of the completed state and save it to '/home/ga/redraw_complete.png'.
